subtitle: XM-4460 Hammer Mill Grinding System (8 Mills) — Corn Ethanol
project: Eight (8) XM-4460 hammer mills for corn grinding — dry-grind ethanol plant
48–50 TPH per mill at 7,200 sq in screen area
Mills set on concrete; plenums hung below on the next floor
Air system (fans, filters, ducting) by W.D. Patterson — Mike King
reference: Basis: Rough Rider hammer mill review of Sep 15, 2026 (C. Schaudt / J. Bliss / M. King) and MCE engineering of Sep 15, 2026
intro: Midwest Custom Engineering is pleased to quote eight (8) XM-4460 extra-heavy-duty hammer mills with feeders, self-cleaning magnet adapters, 350 FPM plenum chambers and plenum transfer screws for corn grinding at the Mid-States ethanol project. Each mill is rated 48–50 TPH on corn with 7,200 sq in of screen area and a 500 HP drive. Toshiba 500 HP main drive motors are listed separately as item 6, with pricing to follow on receipt of the Toshiba quotation; Mid-States may instead purchase the motors directly and ship them to MCE for mounting. The air-relief system is by W.D. Patterson and is not included here.

sections.title: Scope of supply and pricing

items.name: XM-4460 Hammer Mill — Extra Heavy Duty Mill Design
items.description:
Direct drive, dual grinding chamber, gravity discharge hammer mill:
• Motor base extension; reversible top feed inlet; screen carriage
• Screen size: #5 (5/64") — two (4 total) sets of screens included
• Construction: mild steel with AR liners
• 7,200 sq in screen area
• Hammers: hard faced, heat treated — one (1) set included
• HP range 300–600 HP; operating horsepower 500 HP
• Capacity: 48–50 TPH corn; air relief 9,360 CFM @ 6" SP through the mill
• Included: top feed inlet, mill/motor support base, three NEMA 4/12 limit switches, OSHA guard, vibration switch and rubber vibration pads
• Motor: 500 HP, 1800 RPM, 460 V/3/60, TEFC premium efficiency, 1.15 SF (Toshiba, Baldor or Siemens) — **not included in the mill price**; see item 6. Customer-supplied motors are shipped to MCE for mounting and alignment before the mill ships.

items.name: XM-10" AC 14-Row Nylon Cup Feeder with built-in Auto Self-Clean Magnet Adapter
items.description:
• 10" dia. nylon cup rotor, 14 rows; shaft extension, motor base and roller chain drive with safety shield
• 1.608 cu ft/rev; 20.72 RPM at 90% cup fill
• Combo unit built with auto self-clean magnet adapter: stainless steel front, stainless steel hinged magnet plate, air operated with two air cylinders and trash pans; SF300-50" plate magnet
• Micro switch to indicate magnet door open
• Gearhead motor quoted as item 3

items.name: Feeder Gearhead Motor
items.description: 2 HP, 3 PH, 60 Hz, 460 V, TEFC gearhead motor, 40.7 RPM final output — sized for 20.72 RPM feeder speed through the roller chain drive.

items.name: Custom Plenum Chamber — 350 FPM, for XM-4460 (MCE dwg. XM4460-350PL Rev A)
items.description:
• 78" × 78" cross-section, 218-1/8" (18'-2") long over end flanges, 72" deep including 35° hopper bottom to a 19-13/16" wide discharge for the transfer screw trough
• Constructed of 3/16" A36 plate, wrapped every 24" with 2" flat bar
• 10" top flange with bolted 78" × 78" mill mounting opening at the mill end; 55" × 60-3/4" flanged opening at the opposite end for the dust filter / air-relief connection (filter by others)
• Plenum hangs below the mill floor (mill sets on concrete) — no support structure, hangers or floor steel included
• Approximate weight 2,500 lb each; exterior one shop coat grey enamel
• Final length confirmed on approval drawings to suit mill placement

items.name: Transfer Screw Conveyor — 18" dia. × 21'-0", for XM-4460 plenum
items.description:
18" diameter screw conveyor, 21'-0" long inside trough ends, to convey 50 TPH of ground corn at 35 PCF, control fed at 45% trough loading, 46 RPM, horizontal. Trough length suits the 18'-2" plenum on drawing XM4460-350PL; confirmed on approval drawings.
• 18" RH sectional screw, 1/4" flights, full pitch, on 6" Sch 40 pipe, 3-7/16" shafts; Tem-U-Lac coupling bolts
• Anti-friction tail trough end with WPS and lip seal; standard drive trough end with feet
• 18" × 3/16" flared trough 18'-0" long, uncovered to act as inlet, with flared-to-U-trough adaptor plate; 3'-0" single-flanged trough with 12 GA gasketed cover
• 19" × 19" × 3/16" flush end discharge spout; support feet; shroud; flange gaskets and bolt kits
• Drive: Baldor 10 HP, 1750 RPM, 3/60/460 V TEFC 215T motor; Dodge TA4207H25 taper-bushed reducer, class 2 gearing, 46 RPM output; drive shaft, motor mount, sheaves, belts and guard
• Exterior: one shop coat grey enamel; general arrangement drawings for approval before fabrication

items.name: Main Drive Motor — Toshiba 500 HP
items.description: Toshiba 500 HP, 1800 RPM, 460 V/3/60, TEFC premium efficiency, 1.15 SF, 449T frame (Baldor or Siemens equivalent acceptable). Mounted, aligned and guarded on the mill at MCE. **Priced separately** on receipt of the Toshiba quotation; Mid-States may instead purchase the motors directly and ship them to MCE for mounting at no additional charge.

sections.after: Unit prices are quoted for a single order of eight (8) lines. The project discount applies to items 1–5 and will be applied to item 6 when the Toshiba motor price is added.

options.name: Plenum chambers fabricated by Mid-States
options.description: Mid-States may elect to fabricate the plenum chambers to MCE drawings. MCE furnishes fabrication drawings and the mill mounting flange details; items 1–3, 5 and 6 are unchanged. [[Confirm whether MCE supplies the mill mounting flange/adapter with this option.]]

sections.title: Furnished by others
sections.text:
• Air-relief system for the mills — fans, dust control filters, ducting, airlocks and explosion protection — by W.D. Patterson (Mike King), sized to 9,360 CFM @ 6" SP per mill as stated above
• Mill drive motors if supplied by Mid-States (see item 6); motor starters, VFDs and motor control
• Controls, PLC programming and instrumentation beyond the limit switches, vibration switches and magnet micro switches listed
• Concrete, foundations, floor openings, anchor bolts and any support steel for the plenums
• Infeed to the feeders, and conveyance from the transfer screw discharge
• Compressed air to the magnet adapters (air cylinders)
• Installation, millwright, electrical and start-up labor

sections.title: Commercial terms
sections.text: Payment: 50% down with order, balance before shipment. Prices are in US dollars and exclude sales tax, freight and installation. Pricing is valid [[through December 31, 2026]]; steel and motor pricing are subject to adjustment for orders placed after that date. Warranty per MCE standard terms and conditions. This proposal covers the equipment listed in Section 2 only; the air system is quoted separately by W.D. Patterson.
